name: t3_lolbin_proxy_exec
label: true_positive
description: A skilled operator using only binaries already present: a signed system utility loads the payload, the dropped file is given a system filename and backdated, and the security log is cleared at the end.
detectable_as: Parent and child pairing rather than process name, since every binary involved is legitimate and signed. The log clear is the one unambiguous event, and it arrives last.
why_hard: Nothing here has a malicious filename or hash. A detection built on process names sees only Windows utilities. The timestomp defeats file-age heuristics, and the log clear removes the preceding evidence, so the detection has to have already fired.
